Specification: This module tests the handling of one-tuples in TLA+. It defines a variable x, initializes it to TRUE, and leaves it unchanged in the Next action. The set S is defined as the set of all one-tuples <<y>> where y ranges over {1,2,3,4}. The Inv operator contains a series of IF statements that check various properties of one-tuples, such as membership, existential quantification, set comprehension, sequence concatenation, and function application, using Assert and Print to indicate test success or failure. The module is intended as a test suite for tuple and sequence handling, not as a model of a distributed algorithm or protocol.
IfThenElse: IF <<1>> \notin S THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
IF ~(\E <<y>> \in S : y = 2) THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
IF ~(\E y \in S : y[1] = 2) THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
IF {<<y>> \in S : y > 3} # {<<4>>} THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
IF <<1>> \o <<2>> # <<1, 2>> THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 5 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 5 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
IF [<<y>> \in S |-> y+1][<<2>>] # 3 THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 6 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 6 OK", TRUE) (in Inv)
